**Advances:** `specled.coverage_capture`, `specled.triangulation`

Mostly test-only work — the `Advances:` entries exist because `test_tags` enforcement is `error` and any new `@tag spec:` must resolve to a real requirement id.

**Primary files, per finding:**

*F27 — FormatterTest.* `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs:2` is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, while `defp arm/1` at :27 does `Application.put_env(:specled_ex, :spec_cover_run, seam_opts)` and `setup` at :22-25 does `Application.delete_env/2` — a production-read global (`Formatter.armed/0` at `formatter.ex:134`, `Boundary.resolve_config/0` at `boundary.ex:91`). The exact-stderr-line-count assertion is at :89-90 (`lines = output |> String.trim_trailing("\n") |> String.split("\n")` then `assert length(lines) == 1`).

*F28 — MfaLinesTest.* `test/specled_ex/coverage/mfa_lines_test.exs:3` is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, and `defp compile_fixture/2` at :93-129 does `Code.put_compiler_option(:debug_info, true)` at :113 and restores at :119 — a **VM-global** compiler option, racing every other async test that compiles (there are many: `realization/*_test.exs`, `integration/*_test.exs` all call `Kernel.ParallelCompiler.compile_to_path/3`).

The natural home for direct tests is `test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs` (currently `async: true` at :14, `@moduletag spec:` list at :16+, which does **not** yet list `specled.triangulation.per_test_requirement_reach`).

*F38 — **assessed: already fully restored by 731b686; do not write more.*** Verified in detail. `731b686` ("fix(specled_-pzd): record degradation provenance; stop auditing never-ran tests") added `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs:485-513`, *"harvest-only degrade records [:counters_harvested]"*, which:

The path it exercises is `flush/1`'s `boundary_diagnostics` accumulator (`formatter.ex:297`, sourced from `records_for_inventory/4`'s `boundary_row.diagnostics` at :403) feeding `total_diagnostics` at :304 and `:counters_harvested` at :328. - `formatter.ex:273-279` — `source_file/1`'s `_ -> nil` (unrecognized `:source` shape) and the `_ -> nil` non-loadable clause, plus the `rescue _ -> nil` at :280-281;
- `formatter.ex:375-376` — the two dead `||` fallbacks (`fallback_test_key/1`, `inventory_module_from_key/1`) — note **dn4.2 deletes these**, so do not write tests for them;
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:349` — `tests_hitting_mfa(_per_test, nil, _mfa_lines), do: []`;
- `coverage_triangulation.ex:400-404` — `module_source_index/1`'s `nil -> acc`;
- `coverage_triangulation.ex:331-332` — the MfaKey-parse-failure clause folding into `uncovered`;
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex:122-126` — `table_alive?/1`'s `rescue ArgumentError -> false`.
